note: 05A, row A8 applied to `expt`: the integer-signature result overflows int64 at 2^63. Emacs promotes to a bignum and prints 9223372036854775808; fe raises `arith-error`, the same recorded refusal `*` overflow gets. Pinned separately from num-overflow-bignum because `expt` reaches the edge through its own per-signature native, not through the tower's ckd_mul reduction.
